scope: First actual host-connected opt-in IDLE/REST LLM-planning segment under ADR-021; offline implementation and tests only

snapshot_policy.over_limit_or_contended_memory: UNKNOWN; do not truncate or renumber notes, do not block native tick
snapshot_policy.capture: Host-owned deep independent state/public cards/notes; nonblocking locked raw-note snapshot, no summaries/journal reads/writes/migration
snapshot_policy.source_mutations_after_capture: Never alter a running job; independently refresh capabilities and identity at admission

runtime_policy.logical_timeout: Retain physical worker ownership; no replacement until termination confirmed
runtime_policy.failed_join: Explicit unresolved ownership and reconnect refusal; do not detach or claim cleanup succeeded

initial_execution.mechanical_fallback: Disabled for the entire opt-in mode, including pending, invalid and empty admitted actions
initial_execution.CLEF: Execution/safety/replan decisions only, never objective or phase authorship
initial_execution.freeform_chat: Separate port remains open; premade chat only in this segment

acceptance: Six named actual-host cases from frontier plus bounded snapshot tests; strict vertical RED/GREEN, independent completed-snapshot review and unchanged root gates
repair_budget: New finite host feature scope, maximum two named independent-review repair cycles; does not reset any prior exhausted budget
partial_handoff: Preserve working source and all evidence; name exact incomplete caller/contract and authoritative source; no fabricated live acceptance
